checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices are on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices.
The includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears; only basic services is described as added to arrangements selected.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so it is on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so it is on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard, and wood box options, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions cremation and no separate crematory cash advance is listed, so there is no double-billing shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and other mentioned goods have priced lines.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, cemetery or crematory requires a purchase, apart from the wording of required disclosures themselves.
No claim about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and disclosures appear as clear statements.
